SD66-X01.name: The PinnacleDragonEmperor Siegfried-Zenith
SD66-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest BP. Also, during this battle, when this Spirit becomes LV3, if it's your Attack Step, (Once per Turn: Same Name) send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Red "Sieg" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, put a core from the Void each to this Spirit and your Life, and all those Spirits remain on the Field, in the same condition.

SD66-001.name: Goradon 15th
SD66-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can immediately use the Main effect of a "Double Draw" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

SD66-009.name: New Double Draw
SD66-009.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, you can summon one of your "Top Buddy, Aibou" that is in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

[Flash]
During this turn, give one of your "Sieg" +10000 BP.

SD66-003.name: Skelton-Jaw 15th
SD66-003.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon/deploy a "Scarlet Flame" family Brave card/Nexus card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

SD66-002.name: Taurusknight 15th
SD66-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Spirit becomes LV2/LV3 via your effects, you can destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD66-008.name: The 15 Red Pyroxenes
SD66-008.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with "Awaken"-named effects attacks, you can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you have four counters or more, increase the limit of this "BP destruction effect" by +5000.

[LV1] (When Deployed)
Your counter +1.

SD66-CP01.name: The BreakthroughBlade Battle-Saver
SD66-CP01.effect:
[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "Top Buddy, Aibou" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ You can send any number of cores from your Trash to your Spirits.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can draw a card. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[During Advent & During Brave]
While you have six counters or more, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD66-006.name: The DragonicFortress Giga 15th
SD66-006.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD66-004.name: The PinnacleDinosaur Jurassickle-Zenith
SD66-004.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
When your other Spirits are depleted via an effect, your counter +1. Then, you can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon a Cost 6 or less "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

SD66-005.name: The PinnacleDragon Ma-Gwo-Zenith
SD66-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Assault Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you have six counters or more, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +10000.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When you activate an "Awaken"-named effect, you can activate one of this Spirit's (When Summoned) effects. When you've done so, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD66-007.name: The View at the Peak
SD66-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any Red Contract Spirit, increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +3000.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Spirit with "Top Buddy, Aibou" as pre-advent card is attacking, that Spirit gains +10000 BP.

SD66-CX01.name: Top Buddy, Aibou
SD66-CX01.effect:
[CArule]

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] Flash - [Toppa Awaken]
You can put any number of cores from your Reserve/Field to a "Scarlet Flame" family Spirit/Nexus you control. (Once per Turn: Same Name) When cores are put via this effect, your counter +1. Also, if it's your Attack Step, your counter +1.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your Spirits become LV2/LV3 via your "Awaken"-named effects, you can draw a card.
